description_en: Modifies the client IP address and cookie settings of a protected object
description_zh: 修改防护对象的客户端IP和cookie设置
name: ModifyDefenseResourceXff

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether a Layer 7 proxy, such as Anti-DDoS or CDN, is enabled before WAF. Valid values:

0 (default): The proxy is disabled.

1: The proxy is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
WAF前是否开启七层代理（高防/CDN等）。取值：

0（默认）：未开启。

1：开启
parameters.name: xff_status

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of specified header fields.

The first IP address in the specified header field is used as the source IP address of the client to prevent X-Forwarded-For (XFF) spoofing. If multiple headers are specified, the system attempts to obtain the source IP address in sequence. If the first header does not contain an IP address, the system checks the second header, and so on. If no IP address is found in any of the specified headers, the first IP address in the X-Forwarded-For header is used
parameters.help_zh:
指定Header字段列表。

取指定Header字段中的第一个IP作为客户端源IP，避免XFF伪造，输入多个Header时按顺序依次尝试取源IP，如果第一个取不到则取第二个，依次类推，如果所有指定Header都取不到，则取X-Forwarded-For中第一个IP
parameters.name: custom_headers

parameters.help_en:
The name of the protected object.

The protected object must be added to WAF. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461612.html operation to query the name of the protected object
parameters.help_zh:
防护对象名称。

需为已接入WAF的防护对象。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/461612.html接口查询防护对象名称
parameters.name: resource

fields.help_en:
The SameSite policy of the slider cookie. Valid values:

None: None.

Lax: Lax.

Strict: Strict.

An empty string indicates that the SameSite attribute is not configured.   
If the SameSite policy is set to None, the Secure attribute must be enabled for the cookie
fields.help_zh:
滑块 cookie的SameSite策略。取值：

None：表示None。

Lax：表示Lax。

Strict：表示Strict。

空字符串表示不设置SameSite属性。   
SameSite 策略为 None 时，对应 Cookie 必须开启 Secure
fields.name: acw_sc_v3_same_site
